problem: Which of the following is a factor of $3{z}^{2}-24z+75?$

feedback.worked_solution:
First, we let $f(x)=3{x}^{2}-6x+51.$

Next, we solve $f(x)=0$ by completing the square, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =0 \\ 3{x}^{2}-6x+51 & =0 \\ {x}^{2}-2x+17 & =0 \\ ({x}^{2}-2\cdot 1\cdot x+{1}^{2})-{1}^{2}+17 & =0 \\ (x-1)^{2}-1+17 & =0 \\ (x-1)^{2}+16 & =0 \\ (x-1)^{2} & =-16 \\ (x-1)^{2} & =16{\text{i}}^{2} \\ (x-1)^{2} & =(4\text{i})^{2} \\ x-1 & =\pm 4\text{i} \\ x & =1\pm 4\text{i}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since our quadratic equation has roots ${x}_{1}=1+4\text{i}$ and ${x}_{2}=1-4\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the quadratic term is $a=3,$ the expression $3{x}^{2}-6x+51$ can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2}-6x+51 & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2}) \\  & =3(x-(1+4\text{i}))(x-(1-4\text{i})).\end{aligned}
$$
